description:
Compares positions with the orders actually resting at the broker. Flags: a position over the size cap with no resting stop, or a stop covering only part of it; any good-for-day order (gone at the close); resting sells exceeding shares held with no link between the legs; resting orders in names not held. With journal text in this repo's JOURNAL.template.md format, it also checks each written price gate (stops, sell limits, dated exits) against the resting orders and lists any gate it could not read as UNCHECKED rather than passing. Positions: symbol, quantity, and market value or last price. Orders: symbol, side, quantity, order type, limit price, stop price, term (GTC/day), status; the text "none" means no open orders. Nothing pasted is stored. Example: {"positions_csv": "symbol,quantity,last_price
KO,200,70.10
AAPL,120,229.80", "orders_csv": "symbol,side,quantity,order_type,stop_price,term
KO,sell,200,stop,62,GTC", "cap_pct": 25}.

cap_pct.description: Position size, % of the account, above which a stop is expected (default 28)

cash.description: Cash in the account, for position weights (default: a cash row in the export, else 0)

journal_text.description: Optional trading journal in this repo's template format

orders_csv.description: Open orders as CSV text, or "none"

positions_csv.description: Positions export as CSV text, header row included

name: stop_coverage_check
title: Stop coverage check
